relations: The white basin, brown cylinder, marker, and stick pile remain fixed on the sandy surface throughout the sequence.
Bright overhead lighting casts distinct vertical pole and device shadows onto the pale sand.
A temporary drop in illumination causes the pole and device shadows to fade while objects stay in place.
Returning to the brighter state restores the clear shadows without altering the static object layout.
caption:
The video captures a mostly static overhead view of a flat sandy surface holding several objects. A white plastic basin rests in a dark wet-sand patch on the left, while a short brown cylinder lies diagonally near the center beside an upright red-and-black marker.

On the right, a second dark wet-sand patch cradles a tangled pile of brightly colored thin sticks together with a green spoon-shaped item. A thin vertical pole shadow crosses the lower center, and a small device shadow sits at the lower right. The scene is brightly lit in these intervals, so the shadows read clearly against the pale sand, and the objects appear fixed in place and orientation, with no clear translation or rotation.

The visible change is then a temporary dip in illumination. The scene darkens noticeably and the pole and device shadows become faint, while the basin, cylinder, marker, and stick pile remain in place. After this dim interval the lighting returns to the brighter state, the shadows reappear, and the layout stays unchanged through the final view.
